hook: Plumbers: 5 dates that sneak up on you in *December*
title: Plumbing renewals that hide until year-end

items.title: The truck registrations
items.body: Every van renews on its own month. None of them ask first.

items.title: Workers' comp policy
items.body: The renewal email went to the apprentice who left in June.

items.title: Backflow tester certification
items.body: Where it's required, an expired card means no test reports.

items.title: Your liability certificate
items.body: The GC wants this year's COI, not the one from last year.

items.title: Your plumbing license
items.body: Plenty of them renew at year-end. Some want CE hours first.
